A 3-day, 11-session instructor-led course. The hands-on tool is the **Hermes desktop
agent** (Projects, `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md`, Skills, Memory, Cron, Connectors); concepts
stay portable to ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Coworker.

## Slides — Foundation + Expansion

Day 1 is the **Foundation** block, composed from the shared concept library in
[`../chunks/`](../chunks/) (single-sourced across every workshop) plus manager-specific
examples. Days 2–3 are the **Expansion**, each session building on a Foundation artifact.

| 3 | Grounding AI in Truth / Research Workflow | [grounding](slides/grounding.html) |
